purpose: Dynamic coordinate generation from full official sidewalk faces, not fixed known viewpoint list
modelSurfaceAssumption: Terrain DEM+1.5m eye is a model assumption for suitable ground-level surfaces, not a measured standing height. Bridges/elevated/tunnel/underpass need separate surface handling; zero road Z is not ground or deck.
limits: No water classification from geometry alone; water-body filtering is separate.
Source codes can identify bridge/elevated/tunnel at parent Road level, not exact walking deck elevation.
Footpath source geometry does not certify real-time access or standing conditions.
